title: एकपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 151 · Alayudha comes to the battle

summary.en: While Karna and Ghatotkacha fight, the rakshasa Alayudha arrives with his troops, vowing to avenge the death of his kinsmen Kirmira and Baka at Bhima's hands. He comes with a hundred chariots and great kings of his own kind.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ಣ-ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚರು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಿರಲು ಭೀಮ ಕೊಂದ ಬಂಧುಗಳಾದ ಕಿರ್ಮೀರ, ಬಕರ ಸೇಡು ತೀರಿಸಲು ರಾಕ್ಷಸ ಅಲಾಯುಧ ತನ್ನ ಸೈನ್ಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನೂರು ರಥಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ತನ್ನ ಜಾತಿಯ ಮಹಾರಾಜರೊಡನೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कर्ण और घटोत्कच के लड़ते समय राक्षस अलायुध अपनी सेना के साथ आता है और भीम द्वारा मारे गए बन्धुओं किर्मीर और बक का बदला लेने की प्रतिज्ञा करता है। वह सौ रथों और अपनी जाति के महान राजाओं के साथ आता है।
summary.te: కర్ణ ఘటోత్కచులు పోరాడుతుండగా భీముడు చంపిన బంధువులు కిర్మీర, బకుల ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవాలని రాక్షసుడు అలాయుధుడు తన సేనతో వస్తాడు. వంద రథాలతో, తన జాతి మహారాజులతో వస్తాడు.
summary.ta: கர்ணனும் கடோத்கசனும் போரிடுகையில் பீமன் கொன்ற உறவினர் கிர்மீரன், பகன் ஆகியோருக்குப் பழிதீர்க்க அரக்கன் அலாயுதன் தன் படையுடன் வருகிறான். நூறு தேர்களோடும் தன் இனத்து மன்னர்களோடும் வருகிறான்.
summary.ml: കർണ്ണനും ഘടോൽക്കചനും പൊരുതുമ്പോൾ, തന്റെ ബന്ധുക്കളായ കിർമ്മീരനും ബകനും ഭീമന്റെ കൈകളിൽ മരിച്ചതിനു പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുമെന്ന് പ്രതിജ്ഞയെടുത്ത് അലായുധൻ തന്റെ സേനയോടൊപ്പം എത്തുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹം നൂറു രഥങ്ങളും തന്റെ വർഗത്തിലെ മഹാരാജാക്കന്മാരുമായി വരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.151; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने कर्णराक्षसयोर्मृधे ।
अलायुधो राक्षसेन्द्रो वीर्यवानभ्यवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: While that fight between Karna and the rakshasa was going on, the mighty rakshasa lord Alayudha came marching into the battle.

verses.text:
महत्या सेनया युक्तः सुयोधनमुपागमत् ।
राक्षसानां विरूपाणां सहस्रैः परिवारितः ।
नानारूपधरैर्वीरैः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ॥

meaning.en: He came to Duryodhana with a great army, surrounded by thousands of misshapen rakshasas, heroes of every kind of form, all of them remembering an old enmity.

verses.text:
तस्य ज्ञातिर्हि विक्रान्तो ब्राह्मणादो बको हतः ।
किर्मीरश्च महातेजा हिडिम्बश्च सखा तथा ॥

meaning.en: His kinsmen had been slain: the brave Baka, the eater of brahmins, and the powerful Kirmira, and also his friend Hidimba.

verses.text:
स दीर्घकालाध्युषितं पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ।
विज्ञायैतन्निशायुद्धं जिघांसुर्भीममाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Remembering that grudge, nursed for a long time, and learning that this night battle was on, he wished to kill Bhima in the fight.

verses.text:
स मत्त इव मातङ्गः संक्रुद्ध इव चोरगः ।
दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्युद्धलालसः ॥

meaning.en: Eager for combat, like a maddened elephant or an enraged serpent, he spoke these words to Duryodhana.

verses.text:
विदितं ते महाराज यथा भीमेन राक्षसाः ।
हिडिम्बबककिर्मीरा निहता मम बान्धवाः ॥

meaning.en: Alayudha said: Great king, you know how Bhima killed my kinsmen the rakshasas Hidimba, Baka and Kirmira.

verses.text:
परामर्शश्च कन्याया हिडिम्बायाः कृतः पुरा ।
किमन्यद्राक्षसानन्यानस्मांश्च परिभूय ह ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, too, the maiden Hidimba was seized by him. What more is there to say, when he has insulted us rakshasas and myself?

verses.text:
तमहं सगणं राजन्सवाजिरथकुञ्जरम् ।
हैडिम्बं च सहामात्यं हन्तुमभ्यागतः स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: I have come in person to kill him, O king, with his host, horses, chariots and elephants, and the son of Hidimba along with his counsellors.

verses.text:
अद्य कुन्तीसुतान्सर्वान्वासुदेवपुरोगमान् ।
हत्वा संभक्षयिष्यामि सर्वैरनुचरैः सह ।
निवारय बलं सर्वं वयं योत्स्याम पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Today I will kill all the sons of Kunti, with Vasudeva at their head, and devour them together with all their followers. Hold back your whole army; we will fight the Pandavas ourselves.

verses.text:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
प्रतिपूज्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, Duryodhana was delighted. Surrounded by his brothers, he honored him and replied.

verses.text:
त्वां पुरस्कृत्य सगणं वयं योत्स्यामहे परान् ।
न हि वैरान्तमनसः स्थास्यन्ति मम सैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana said: We will fight the enemy with you at our head and with your host, for my soldiers, whose hearts are bent on ending this feud, will not stand idle.

verses.text:
एवमस्त्विति राजानमुक्त्वा राक्षसपुंगवः ।
अभ्ययात्त्वरितो भीमं सहितः पुरुषाशनैः ॥

meaning.en: Saying 'So be it' to the king, that bull among rakshasas quickly advanced against Bhima, together with his man-eating warriors.

verses.text:
दीप्यमानेन वपुषा रथेनादित्यवर्चसा ।
तादृशेनैव राजेन्द्र यादृशेन घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: He rode a blazing chariot with the brilliance of the sun, just like the one Ghatotkacha had, O best of kings.

verses.text:
तस्याप्यतुलनिर्घोषो बहुतोरणचित्रितः ।
ऋक्षचर्मावनद्धाङ्गो नल्वमात्रो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Its rumble too was beyond compare, it was decked with many arches and hung with bearskins, and the great chariot-warrior stood a nalva in size.

verses.text:
तस्यापि तुरगाः शीघ्रा हस्तिकायाः खरस्वनाः ।
शतं युक्ता महाकाया मांसशोणितभोजनाः ॥

meaning.en: His horses also were swift, huge as elephants, braying like asses, a hundred of them yoked, big-bodied and fed on flesh and blood.

verses.text:
तस्यापि रथनिर्घोषो महामेघरवोपमः ।
तस्यापि सुमहच्चापं दृढज्यं बलवत्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: The roar of his chariot was like a great thundercloud, and his huge bow had a strong, firm string.

verses.text:
तस्याप्यक्षसमा बाणा रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः ।
सोऽपि वीरो महाबाहुर्यथैव स घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: His arrows too were as thick as chariot axles, gold-feathered and whetted on stone. That mighty-armed hero was in every way like Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
तस्यापि गोमायुबडाभिगुप्तो
बभूव केतुर्ज्वलनार्कतुल्यः ।
स चापि रूपेण घटोत्कचस्य
श्रीमत्तमो व्याकुलदीपितास्यः ॥

meaning.en: His banner too, guarded by flocks of jackals, shone like fire and the sun. His face, bright and wild, was handsome and much like Ghatotkacha's.

verses.text:
दीप्ताङ्गदो दीप्तकिरीटमाली
बद्धस्रगुष्णीषनिबद्धखड्गः ।
गदी भुशुण्डी मुसली हली च
शरासनी वारणतुल्यवर्ष्मा ॥

meaning.en: With shining armlets and a gleaming diadem and garlands, with a turban bound on and a sword tied at his side, he carried a mace, a bhushundi, a pestle, a plough and a bow, and his body was like an elephant's.

verses.text:
रथेन तेनानलवर्चसा च
विद्रावयन्पाण्डववाहिनीं ताम् ।
रराज संख्ये परिवर्तमानो
विद्युन्माली मेघ इवान्तरिक्षे ॥

meaning.en: On that fiery chariot he drove the Pandava army into flight, and as he wheeled about in battle he shone like a cloud in the sky wreathed in lightning.

verses.text:
ते चापि सर्वे प्रवरा नरेन्द्रा
महाबला वर्मिणश्चर्मिणश्च ।
हर्षान्विता युयुधुस्तत्र राज-
न्समन्ततः पाण्डवयोधवीराः ॥

meaning.en: And all those excellent kings, mighty, armored and shielded, the Pandava heroes, joyfully fought him there on every side, O king.
